name: defold core
description: Structure, wire and verify a Defold game: editor resource files, the Lua script lifecycle, addressing and messages, runtime spawning and world loading, and a Bob build-and-run check. Examples target Defold 1.14.0; they were built with Bob 1.14.0 and run on the 1.14.0 headless engine. An existing project keeps its Defold version (see Version(#version)).
